title: Clinical Love
author: Asjad Ullah
description: Emotionally troubled psychiatrist Dr. Rick falls madly in love with his patient Sarah. Rick’s blind love leads him to a reality he doesn’t want to accept.

parts.prologue: Dr. Rick has seen Sarah every Tuesday and Thursday for eight months. He calls her his best patient. Lately he has stopped writing notes about their sessions.

messages.text: How you doing baby?
Hey, I am good. What about you?
I am great.
Just can’t wait for the next session.
Hmmm.
Aren’t you excited?
I am not so sure Rick.
Not so sure?
You are nearly back to being yourself.
Missing therapy sessions won’t help.
I want to tell you something important.
What is it sweetheart? You can share anything with me.
After all, I am your Doctor. ;)
Rick, we can’t have the therapy sessions any more.
We have to stop.
What? What do you mean by stop?
It’s a treatment, why should we stop?
It’s complicated.
What is complicated darling?
Have you been skipping your medicines?
You are just acting like at the start of your treatment.
C’mon Sarah, what’s bothering you?
Speak up love.
I didn’t want to break your heart.
Okay, Sarah you are scaring me now.
I am coming over right now.
No don’t come over.
I am afraid, you won’t be able to accept the reality.
What reality Sarah?
We both love each other, isn’t that the reality?
It’s not true.
Our love is not true? What are you saying?
It’s not what you think.
Then what? Explain it to me?
It’s deeper than that.
Sarah! Will you please give it to me straight.
I can’t.
I am afraid you might have a nervous breakdown.
Woah…Is it that hard?
It’s worse.
Enough of the drama Sarah; speak up now.
How will you ever forgive me? 
It was my idea.
And now, I don’t even know what to do.
Look Sarah, you don’t seem ok to me right now.
Take some rest and we will talk later.
I am perfectly fine.
It’s you Rick.
You are not fine.
What do you mean I am not fine?
We have been together for months now.
What about the evenings we spent together?
What about the sessions Sarah?
Nothing is as it seems.
What do you mean?
You have lost it Sarah.
Please hold on tight.
I am about to tell you something really shocking.
And I am not sure how you will react.
I am all ears Sarah, just cut out the suspense.
All those therapy sessions Rick.
Yeah what about them?
They were not my therapy sessions.
I am not getting what you are saying Sarah.
What do you mean they were not my sessions?
Yes Rick, I am speaking the truth.
You are not a doctor. Not anymore.
Sarah I am not getting any of this.
You were a Psychiatrist before the accident.
What accident?
You had a major accident last year.
An accident? Why don’t I remember anything about it?
You lost your memory in the accident.
You lost your memory and emotions.
Everything was gone.
And then what happened?
You were supposed to undergo a special treatment.
You were to be emotionally excited to bring back your emotions.
But if I was so emotionless, how do I love you?
Isn’t love an emotion too?
You have recovered emotionally.
But your memory has not returned.
And what about our love Sarah?
You don’t even know who I am.
Why should I believe a single word from you?
You are a mental patient suffering from memory loss.
No Rick, I am not a mental patient.
You are lying; I have seen your files so many times.
Oh my God!
I get it now, this is your story.
You had an accident, followed by a memory loss.
That was all made up to bring your memory back.
You are lying. Why should I believe a mental patient?
I am not a mental patient.
You can’t even prove this Sarah.
I feel so sorry for you.
Don’t worry Sarah you will recover soon.
It was basically my idea.
To try this therapy with you.
I am your doctor, Sarah.
I am a successful psychiatrist.
And we love each other.
No Rick. I am your doctor and you are a mental patient.
And our love, it was a part of the treatment.
I am sorry, I couldn’t bring you back.
You don’t love me Sarah?
My name is Dr. Martha.
Sarah was your wife’s name.
It was a made up name to help bring back your memory.
What? And where is she now?
She passed away Rick.
She was driving, when you two suffered the accident.
What about my love Sarah?
It was not love Rick, it was your treatment.
